entries.headline: Six US transports and command, surveillance and Russian jet sightings reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States. It also reported sightings of a nuclear command aircraft, a surveillance aircraft and a Russian government jet, without identifying their missions or establishing a connection between them.

entries.headline: Six transports over the US and North Sea; no coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea, plus sightings of a Russian Il-96 and a US surveillance aircraft. It reported no coded US Air Force broadcasts detected during that hour.

entries.headline: North Sea and UK transport activity described as above usual levels
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US military transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and United Kingdom, alongside a surveillance aircraft over the United States. It described activity as busier than usual for that hour without identifying aircraft callsigns or missions.

entries.headline: Surveillance flight, six transports and no coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft airborne, six military transport jets in the air, and a Russian aircraft sighting over the Middle East. It reported no coded radio broadcasts detected during that hour, without identifying aircraft missions or linking the sightings.

entries.headline: Six transports across the US, North Sea and eastern Mediterranean reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft airborne and six military transport aircraft detected across the United States, North Sea and eastern Mediterranean during the preceding hour. The post did not identify callsigns, routes or missions.

entries.headline: Transport, surveillance and nuclear command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft airborne, multiple military transport flights and a nuclear command jet detection. It also reported sightings of a Navy transport and a Russian Il-96, without specifying their locations or missions.

entries.headline: War Watch relays Putin visit and embassy evacuation statement
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a report of a Putin visit to a Russian region and a statement attributed to Ukraine's foreign minister that an embassy was not planning an evacuation, crediting @Robertchester-j5b. The visible post did not identify the embassy or a clear news source.

entries.headline: War Watch shares report of new Ukrainian drone interceptors
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared an Independent report that Zelensky had unveiled new drone interceptors, with hundreds in production, crediting @Robertchester-j5b. The visible post did not identify the interceptor models or provide a production timetable.

entries.headline: US transport, surveillance and command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US military transport aircraft airborne over the United States alongside a surveillance aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft. It also reported a North Korean ballistic missile launch earlier that day, without establishing a connection with the flights.

entries.headline: War Watch reports missile test confirmation and elevated US air activity
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a North Korean ballistic missile launch and attributed confirmation of the test to Japan's Defense Ministry. It also described US military transport and surveillance activity as elevated; the visible post did not specify aircraft missions or a complete operating area.

entries.headline: Six US transports and wider military developments reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over and near the United States. The same post reported a North Korean ballistic missile launch and Ukrainian drone strikes deep into Russia, without identifying specific aircraft missions or independently substantiating those events.

entries.headline: Suspected missile launch, US flights and Hormuz attacks reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a suspected North Korean ballistic missile launch, US military transport and command aircraft airborne over the United States, and continuing tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. The post did not identify aircraft callsigns or establish a connection between these reports.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military P-8 Poseidon at Orange Park, Florida. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: BP42R P-8 departure alert at Manavalakurichi
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for BP42R, described as an Indian military P-8 Poseidon, at Manavalakurichi, India. The post reported a departure without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: E6 departure alert at Midwest City
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military aircraft labeled E6 at Midwest City, Oklahoma. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the flight's destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: BP42R P-8 departure alert near Uthukkottai
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for BP42R, described as an Indian military P-8, near Uthukkottai, India. The post reported detection after takeoff without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report of Finland's first F-35 arrival
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a MilitaryLeak report on Finland and Lockheed Martin celebrating the arrival of the first Finnish F-35. Its accompanying commentary said Finland had welcomed its first two F-35A fighters; the post did not provide independent confirmation or delivery dates.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on C-390 industrialization plans in India
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a MilitaryLeak report that Embraer and Mahindra Group were advancing plans to industrialize the C-390 Millennium in India. The visible post described manufacturing and support plans rather than a completed production facility or confirmed aircraft delivery.

entries.headline: E-6 ground alert at Bellevue
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a US military E-6 TACAMO aircraft at Bellevue, Nebraska. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a specific mission or reason for its ground status.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Hakuromachi
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 Poseidon at Hakuromachi, Japan. Its callsign field contained 00000000; the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or mission.

entries.headline: ASY169 P-8 departure alert at Maeda
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for ASY169, described as a Royal Australian Air Force P-8 Poseidon, at Maeda, Japan. The post reported a departure without confirming its destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Nakijin
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military P-8 at Nakijin, Japan. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or mission.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report of Super Hornet submarine kill marking
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared an Aviationist report describing a VFA-41 F/A-18F Super Hornet returning from Operation Epic Fury with a submarine kill marking. Its commentary attributed the marking to an Iranian submarine engagement from USS Abraham Lincoln; the post relayed the report rather than providing independent confirmation.

entries.headline: New P-8 ground alert at Oak Harbor
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued another ON Ground alert for a US military P-8 at Oak Harbor, Washington. This separately dated post did not supply a callsign or confirm the reason for the aircraft's ground status or a specific mission.
